title: Arithmetic Duality Theorems
version: Second edition, 2006; electronic version July 1, 2006, viii+339 pages.

used_locators.scope: Hochschild-Serre spectral sequence and its low-degree inflation-restriction sequence.
Local Tate duality for abelian varieties in characteristic zero. With elliptic selfduality it identifies H^1(Q_ell,E)[p] with the dual of E(Q_ell)/p.

role: Primary global-cohomology spectral-sequence and local Tate-duality interfaces.
